name: Cheese Bank LP oracle priced from spot pair reserves
summary: CheesePriceOracle.fetchLPAnchorPrice() values a Uniswap V2 LP token as `wETH.balanceOf(pair) * 2 * ethPrice / pair.totalSupply()`, a single-block spot read of the pair's WETH balance. Every non-LP asset in the same contract is priced through fetchAnchorPrice(), which reads Uniswap's cumulative-price accumulator over a TWAP window; the LP branch has no accumulator, no window and no sanity band. refresh() is permissionless, so an attacker could swap 20,000 ETH into the CHEESE/WETH pair, call refresh in the same transaction to write the inflated LP price into `prices`, and then borrow against LP collateral through the Comptroller's ordinary borrow() checks.
notes: CheesePriceOracle is a non-upgradeable contract created directly by an EOA, with its whole TokenConfig array fixed in constructor arguments and no implementation slot or delegatecall. Its runtime hashes to 0xa648fc87e532b50bfa445cb5ac06ee5d0a7a41f68abaec48c48d4a6d98edc500 both at the creation block 11061144 and at block 11205647 immediately before the exploit.

Reconstructed from the exploit receipt, not from reporting. Logs 193, 197 and 201 are the three Cheese Bank markets paying the attacker contract: 2068252649482 USDC units from 0x5e181bdde2fa8af7265cb3124735e9a13779c021, 1237995403809 USDT units from 0x4c2a8a820940003cfe4a16294b239c8c55f29695 and 87586864453785145669360 DAI wei from 0xa80e737ded94e8d2483ec8d2e52892d9eb94cf1f. All three are par-valued dollar stablecoins. The 21000 ETH dYdX flash loan and the 50 ETH used to buy CHEESE are attacker-supplied inputs and are not loss. Cheese Bank retained the 2833.226849227665 CHEESE/WETH UNI-V2 LP tokens the attacker had deposited into market 0x7e4956688367fb28de3c0a62193f59b1526a00e7 at log 180, but that collateral was itself attacker-supplied and, once the 20000 ETH manipulation swap was unwound inside the same transaction, worth a small fraction of the stablecoins removed, so the gross depletion is reported without netting it. No ETH-denominated market paid out in this transaction.

Which oracle the Comptroller consults is configuration, but the defect measured here is inside the deployed oracle's own LP pricing function, so the oracle's deployment is the executable-code age basis and the market listing and collateral factors are context.
